test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

They said, "Please bring the basket here."

options.text: They requested to take the basket here.
They requested me to take the basket there.
They requested me to bring the basket there.
They requested me to bring the basket here.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They requested me to bring the basket there.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Please bring the basket here" becomes "requested me to bring the basket there."**
 
 
• The word "please" is replaced with the verb "requested" to indicate politeness in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun "here" changes to "there" to reflect the change in perspective in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "They said"
 
• Converted to: "They requested," to appropriately match the polite request made in the direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks in the original sentence.
 
• In indirect speech, quotation marks are removed, and the sentence is restructured appropriately.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They requested me to bring the basket there."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "They requested to take the basket here."

 
 
• Incorrect because "to take" does not match the action described in the original request.
 
• The pronoun "here" is not changed to "there," which is required in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "They requested me to bring the basket here."
 
 
• Incorrect because the pronoun "here" is not changed to "there," which is required in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "They requested me to bring the basket here."
 
 
• Duplicate of Option 3, incorrect for the same reason.
